overall_notes: The paper focuses on NLG evaluation through instruction following in narrative contexts. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundancy and inconsistent formatting. The paper uses both automatic metrics and LLM/human evaluation comprehensively. The main NLG tasks are dialogue and story generation in interactive narrative settings.
